description: Returns live French editorial calendar dates ('marronniers') for Sept 2026 to Dec 2027 from the Les Créavores open dataset: world days, holidays, school holidays, seasons, public holidays and retail events, each with start/end date, label, type, sectors, source and a content angle. Optional filters: from/to (YYYY-MM-DD, overlap match), sector (also returns dates common to all sectors, 'tous') and limit. Every answer carries source, licence, date and citation.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (events ending on or after it)

sector.description: Sector as written in the dataset, e.g. sante, beaute, artisanat, restauration, immobilier, commerce, b2b

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (events starting on or before it)

name: get_marronniers
